description: ai-env egress proxy: security updates of the latest AL2023 release (dnf bounded inside this document's timeout, its output in /var/log/ai-env-proxy-patch.log, its last 20 lines printed), then a squid restart

runCommand: timeout -k 30 1740 dnf -y upgrade --security --releasever=latest >"$log" 2>&1 || { rc=$?; tail -n 20 "$log" >&2; exit "$rc"; }
